_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for European Research Council (ERC) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the work-programme JSON, queries AI-authored + adversarially verified in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls (and broad funding instruments such as ERC/MSCA) these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"erc"} to apply.

queries.ERC 2026 PERA: contenttype=project AND ("European Research Council" OR "ERC" OR "frontier research") AND ("curiosity-driven research" OR "scientific excellence" OR "excellent science" OR "principal investigator")
queries.ERC CONSOLIDATOR GRANTS: contenttype=project AND ("European Research Council" OR "ERC" OR "frontier research") AND ("Consolidator Grant" OR "established researcher" OR "independent research team" OR "scientific excellence")
queries.ERC STARTING GRANTS: contenttype=project AND ("European Research Council" OR "ERC" OR "frontier research") AND ("Starting Grant" OR "early-career researcher" OR "early career" OR "independent research career")
queries.ERC SYNERGY GRANTS: contenttype=project AND ("European Research Council" OR "ERC" OR "frontier research") AND ("Synergy Grant" OR "collaborative research" OR "interdisciplinary research" OR "principal investigators")
